description: This PHP class 'ProjectActivityDetailedReportData' implements report data processing for a detailed project activity report within the OrangeHRM system. It retrieves project activity details based on filter parameters, normalizes employee activity data for reporting, and provides metadata including total duration and project activity info.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportData
classes.description: A class implementing report data retrieval and normalization for detailed project activity reports, using various helper traits and service dependencies within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the report with filter parameters.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Retrieves project activity data, processes employee activity durations, and returns a normalized array for reporting.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the report including count, total hours/minutes, and project activity details.
